content:
Izzy (SRE): Posted postmortem for the dedicated tenant-crossflow incident (VPC peering flapped, on-prem route-policy allowed unexpected subnet). Short: failover timing + malformed route-map = cross-VNI traffic. Doc: internal link.

incident-bot: New postmortem created: /incidents/1887654321-crossflow-postmortem.md :rotating_light:

Noah (Platform): Can we capture concrete owners & dates here so I can open infra tickets?

Izzy (SRE): Actions (brief):
- Add peering health daemon (control-plane + data-plane TCP probe) — owner: Noah (Platform) — due: 2026-06-07
- On-prem policy detection e2e test + fixtures — owner: Sam (Support) — due: 2026-06-14
- Dedicated onboarding isolation check (passive default, opt-in active) — owner: Sam (Support) — due: 2026-06-01
- One-page NOC safe-checklist + customer comms — owner: Pri (Customer Success) — due: 2026-05-30
- Add onboarding linter rule to flag default-originate w/o next-hop validation — owner: Noah (Platform) — due: 2026-06-10

Sam (Support): I'll build the verification script. Plan: passive-first (`ip route`, `ip neigh`, `iptables -L -n`), optional active `tcpdump -c50` if customer consents. ETA 4 days.

Noah (Platform): I'll open INF-6012 for the probe + PR today. Probe design: daemonset run from node netns, dual-check: `describe-vpc-peering-connections` + `nc -vz <peer-ip> 5222`. Any objections?

Vera (Security): Ensure probes don't leak customer IPs in logs. Use redaction env + restricted S3 bucket for artifact uploads.

Pri (Customer Success): I'll draft comms and NOC checklist; sending to legal now (~48h). Request: include a short set of commands customers can run for quick verification.

Izzy (SRE): Recurring pattern note: this is the 3rd peering-route related isolation in 10 months. Proposal: monthly "isolation-pattern" retro to surface config anti-patterns and inform linter rules. Owner: Izzy. Start: 2026-06-03.

Noah (Platform): Adding INF-6013 for the onboarding linter. Will include rule examples and unit tests.

Sam (Support): Question: many customers won't share on-prem logs. Confirming passive-only mode is the default?

Izzy (SRE): Confirmed. Passive-only default; active debug requires explicit customer opt-in. Document both in runbook.

Noah (Platform): I'll link INF-6012/6013 PRs and issue numbers into the postmortem. Please update the postmortem follow-ups section when PRs land.

Izzy (SRE): I'll run a 2-week follow-up check on 2026-06-17 to verify progress and close items. Everyone please add ticket/PR links to the tracker before then.

All: :white_check_mark:
